EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Have you buried that {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}I gave
you? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Don't forget—It should be in
with the letters you're carrying.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Now, don't peek inside it.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Just bury the capsule, OK?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Ya has enterrado la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
terroncín?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La encontrarás en tus
bolsillos, con tus cartas.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Ni se te ocurra abrirla!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Solo entiérrala, ¿vale?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}As-tu enterré la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que je
t'avais confiée ? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tu l'avais glissée
parmi tes lettres.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Et je compte sur toi pour ne pas
regarder ce qu'elle contient, c'est
personnel, une {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule temporelle{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
Pense à l'enterrer bientôt s'il te
plaît.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Hai già sotterrato la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsula{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che
ti ho dato? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ricorda che la troverai
dove tieni le tue lettere.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}E non aprirla!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Sotterrala e basta,
intesi?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Verdiğim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}kapsülü {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}gömdün mü?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Unutma,
taşıdığın mektupların arasında olmalı.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Şimdi içine bakmak yok.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Kapsülü göm yeter, tamam mı?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}You're still carrying around the
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}I gave you, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}aren't you?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}I think it's with the letters you're
carrying. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Now,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} don't peek inside.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
Just bury it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} all right?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿A que todavía no has enterrado
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que te di?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Está donde guardas tus cartas.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Entiérrala pronto, por favor, y
sin mirar dentro!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}J'imagine que tu as encore sur toi la
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que je t'ai confiée ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Tu l'as rangée avec tes lettres.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Veux-tu bien aller l'enterrer,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} s'il te
plaît ?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Et je compte sur toi pour ne pas
regarder ce qu'elle contient. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}C'est
personnel.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ancora non hai sotterrato
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsula{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che ti ho dato?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mettila dove tieni le tue lettere.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ah... Niente sbirciatine! Sotterrala
e basta, va bene?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ich nehme an, du hast die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zeitkapsel{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
noch, die ich dir gegeben habe?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Sie ist bei den Briefen, die du
mit dir herumträgst.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Aber nicht
hineinsehen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}nur vergraben!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}So, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, you're still carrying
my {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} around, aren't you?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}It should be in with the letters
you're carrying, so you can find it
there when you find a burial spot.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}But don't peek inside it, OK?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Todavía no has enterrado
mi {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}La tienes en los bolsillos, con
tus cartas.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Busca un buen sitio
y entiérrala, ¿vale?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡No la abras!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}j'imagine que tu
as toujours sur toi la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que je
t'avais confiée ?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tu l'avais mise parmi les lettres
que tu portais,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} pour la retrouver
plus facilement.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}S'il te plaît, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}va l'enterrer dès que
possible.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Mais ne regarde pas à
l'intérieur, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}tu m'as bien comprise ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Allora, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ancora non hai
sotterrato la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsula{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} che ti avevo
dato?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Quando finalmente sceglierai dove
sotterrarla, la troverai tra le tue
lettere.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma non guardarci dentro, intesi?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich nehme an, du hast
die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zeitkapsel{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} noch, die ich dir
gegeben habe?
Sie ist bei den Briefen, die du
mit dir herumträgst.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Und du weißt ja: {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Vergraben, aber
nicht hineinsehen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Yani, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, benim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}kapsülümü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} hâlâ
taşıyorsun, değil
mi?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Mektuplarının arasında
olmalı; gömecek yer bulunca oradan alırsın.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ama içine bakmak yok, tamam mı?
